text: Jordan met Dev, a session musician and bassist, for coffee and a walk at Greenwood Park, feeling nervous beforehand but easing into comfortable conversation, including an unplanned reveal about Coda that led Dev to ask thoughtful, engaged questions about it. Sitting by the pond watching a heron, Jordan felt calmed for the first time in weeks after being wound up by work stress, and left the afternoon feeling lighter but intentionally undefined about what's developing with Dev. No firm decisions were made, aside from Jordan choosing not to label the connection prematurely.
